title: 11. Round and Round Goes the Rotor
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Whir, whir! A loud spinning sound comes from the sky. Hori looks up and sees a red helicopter floating above, its big rotor turning round and round! Wow! How can it stay in the sky without airplane wings? Whir! Round and round goes the rotor!

Dad, airplanes run a long way before taking off, but that one goes straight up! Hori asks excitedly. Bori's eyes grow round, too. Dad smiles. Shall we visit the place where helicopters land? Bori can come along!

A big circle and the letter H mark the ground in a wide yard. This is the helipad, where helicopters land. A red helicopter rests gently on it. Hello! Have you come to learn about helicopters? The pilot waves. Hori's heart goes thump, thump!
The big blades above our heads are called the rotor. They spin very fast and push air downward. That force lifts the helicopter straight up. It doesn't need a runway! Hori's mouth falls open.

Hori looks at the tail and finds another small spinning rotor. Why is that one there? If only the big rotor turned, the body would spin around. The tail rotor helps hold it steady. Bori nods. Whir! Round and round goes the rotor!

Above the side door hang a long cable and a large basket. That's a rescue basket. If someone is in trouble in the mountains or at sea, we lower the basket, help them inside, and lift them up to safety. Hori and Bori's eyes grow huge.

Would Hori like to sit in the cockpit? He clicks his safety belt and puts on a big headset. The pilot's voice sounds clear in his ears. Buttons shine in front of him. Bori points to them. What's this round one? The pilot smiles. Look first, touch later. You're looking carefully, Bori!

As the pilot works the controls, the rotor spins faster. Whir! The helicopter gently rises from the helipad! The ground grows smaller below, and Hori can see the whole world. His tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. Wow! I'm flying in the sky! Whir! Round and round goes the rotor!

Just after they land gently, the radio beeps. Someone is hurt in the mountains! Time to go! The pilot quickly fastens a helmet and climbs into the cockpit. The rotor whirs, and the helicopter rises and heads toward the mountains. Hori and Bori wave. Please rescue them!

On the way home, Hori holds Dad's hand and chats. The big rotor lifts it straight up, the tail rotor keeps it steady, and the basket rescues people! The pilot flies to help people in danger. Hori smiles at the sky. Whir! Round and round goes the rotor!
